GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.rule: Never drive faster than the signed speed limit for your road.
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.why: Lower speeds give you time to spot hazards and stop safely.
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.mistake: Waiting until after a lower speed sign before slowing down.

GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.rule: Leave at least 1.5 metres when passing a cyclist up to 30 mph.
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.why: Cyclists may swerve around potholes or drains without warning.
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.mistake: Squeezing past a cyclist in the same lane near oncoming traffic.

GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.rule: Check mirrors and blind spots, then signal before moving into another lane.
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.why: Another vehicle or rider can sit hidden beside your rear quarter.
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.mistake: Drifting across lane lines without checking your blind spot first.

GB.SIG.TIMELY.rule: Signal clearly in good time before turning or changing lanes, then cancel it.
GB.SIG.TIMELY.why: Early signals let other drivers and pedestrians plan safely around you.
GB.SIG.TIMELY.mistake: Signalling as you turn, or leaving an indicator on afterwards.

GB.SIG.MISLEADING.rule: Cancel your indicator promptly after turning and avoid misleading signals.
GB.SIG.MISLEADING.why: A lingering signal makes waiting drivers pull out in front of you.
GB.SIG.MISLEADING.mistake: Leaving your indicator flashing for several seconds after a turn.

GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.rule: Keep to the left lane unless you are overtaking or turning right.
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.why: Staying left keeps faster traffic flowing smoothly on your right.
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.mistake: Cruising in the middle or right lane when the left lane is clear.

GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.rule: Give way to traffic already on the roundabout from your right.
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.why: Roundabout traffic has priority so the junction stays moving safely.
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.mistake: Pulling out in front of a fast vehicle approaching from the right.

GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.rule: Choose the left lane for left or ahead, and right for right turns.
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.why: The right approach lane avoids cutting across other drivers on the roundabout.
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.mistake: Approaching in the left lane when turning right past 12 o'clock.

GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.rule: Follow the lane markings and stay in your lane on multi-lane roundabouts.
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.why: Drifting sideways puts you into the path of cars alongside you.
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.mistake: Cutting across the inside lane when taking a spiral exit.

GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.rule: Signal left for left exits, right for right exits, none for ahead.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.why: Clear approach signals tell waiting drivers whether you will cross them.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.mistake: Signalling left before entering when you are going straight ahead.

GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.rule: Signal left right after passing the exit before the one you want.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.why: Waiting traffic knows you are leaving and can enter safely.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.mistake: Forgetting to signal left before leaving the roundabout.

GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.rule: Always travel clockwise around the central island of a UK roundabout.
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.why: Going anti-clockwise sends you head-on into oncoming roundabout traffic.
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.mistake: Turning right directly in front of a mini-roundabout island.

GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.rule: Leave at least a two-second gap behind the vehicle ahead on dry roads.
GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.why: Two seconds gives you enough time to react and brake smoothly.
GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.mistake: Tailgating in moving traffic where a sudden stop causes a crash.

GB.TL.RED.rule: Stop behind the white stop line whenever the traffic light is red.
GB.TL.RED.why: Crossing traffic and pedestrians have a green signal when yours is red.
GB.TL.RED.mistake: Rolling past the white line while waiting for the lights to change.

GB.TL.AMBER.rule: Stop at an amber light unless you are too close to stop safely.
GB.TL.AMBER.why: Amber warns that red is next and cross traffic will soon move.
GB.TL.AMBER.mistake: Speeding up to beat an amber light from far back.

GB.TL.RED_AMBER.rule: Wait behind the stop line on red and amber until green shows.
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.why: Cross traffic or pedestrians may still be clearing the junction.
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.mistake: Moving off early as soon as the amber light joins the red.

GB.TL.ASL.rule: Stop behind the first white line of a cycle box on red.
GB.TL.ASL.why: The painted box keeps cyclists visible and safe ahead of traffic.
GB.TL.ASL.mistake: Stopping inside the cycle box instead of behind the first line.

GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.rule: Slow down and give way to major-road traffic at broken white lines.
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.why: Vehicles on the main road have priority and may travel fast.
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.mistake: Emerging onto the main road and forcing another driver to brake.

GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.rule: Bring your vehicle to a complete stop at a Stop sign line.
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.why: Stop signs mark junctions where your view of cross traffic is poor.
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.mistake: Rolling slowly over the solid white line without stopping completely.

GB.SCH.SLOW.rule: Slow down past school warning signs and watch closely for children.
GB.SCH.SLOW.why: Children can step out suddenly from behind parked cars near schools.
GB.SCH.SLOW.mistake: Keeping full street speed past a school sign or flashing amber lights.

GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.rule: Keep left when turning left and give way to cycle lanes you cross.
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.why: Swinging out wide or cutting across cyclists risks a side collision.
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.mistake: Turning left across a cyclist riding straight ahead on your inside.

GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.rule: Wait for a safe gap in oncoming traffic before turning right.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.why: Oncoming vehicles travel faster than they look and have priority.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.mistake: Cutting across an oncoming car and making it brake sharply.

GB.XNG.ZEBRA.rule: Stop and give way to anyone waiting at or on a zebra crossing.
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.why: Pedestrians have priority on zebra crossings and expect traffic to stop.
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.mistake: Driving over the stripes while someone is waiting on the kerb.

GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.rule: Give way to pedestrians crossing or waiting to cross a side road.
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.why: Rule H2 puts pedestrians first when you turn in or out.
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.mistake: Turning quickly into a side road in front of a waiting pedestrian.

GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.rule: Never overtake or park on the white zig-zag lines beside a crossing.
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.why: Passing a stopped car hides pedestrians already walking across the road.
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.mistake: Overtaking a slow car inside the zig-zag zone before a zebra crossing.

GB.JCT.BOX.rule: Do not enter a yellow box junction unless your exit road is clear.
GB.JCT.BOX.why: Stopping inside the box blocks cross traffic when the lights change.
GB.JCT.BOX.mistake: Following slow traffic into the box and getting stuck on red.
